name: Domain-Specific Algebraic Obfuscation
description: Replaced the algebraically simplifiable inequality with a modular arithmetic condition `(S[u]+S[v])^3 % (S[u]*S[v]) != 0`. This is equivalent to `S[u] != S[v]` only on the specific domain {1, 2, 3}, defeating symbolic simplification tools and forcing pattern-matching models into using heavy constraint solvers which will TLE.
